name: Hatch size
description: Average size at hatch

name: Asymptotic Size
description: The largest size an individual is expected to obtain

name: vonBertalanffy growth rate
description: Exponential parameter in size-dependent vonBertalanffy growth function

name: Growth rate variance adults
description: Derived growth rate variance parameter for adults from delta method derivation

name: Growth rate variance hatchlings
description: Derived growth rate variance parameter for juveniles from delta method derivation

name: Density dependent logical
description: Does the scenario use density dependence for growth?
units: TRUE if density dependent, FALSE if not [boolean]

name: Density dependence rate
description: Exponential rate parameter for strength of density dependent growth

name: Allometric slope
description: Allometric scaling "slope" (slope in log-log form) parameter from length to biomass

name: Allometric intercept
description: Allometric scaling "intercept" (intercept in log-log form) parameter from length to biomass

name: Minimum survival probability
description: Minimum daily size-dependent survival probability for smallest individuals

name: Maximum survival probability
description: Maximum daily size-dependent survival probability for largest individuals

name: Logistic survival rate
description: Transition rate between 's_min' and 's_max'

name: Logistic survival inflection size
description: Daily survival inflection parameter

name: Post spawning mortality
description: Probability of mortality after spawning event

name: Reproductively mature size
description: Threshold size cutoff for individuals to become reproductively active

name: Daily spawning probability
description: Average daily probability of spawning

name: Sex ratio of hatchlings
description: Sex ratio of hatchlings

name: Fecundity slope
description: Fecundity "slope" (slope in log-log form) parameter from length to eggs/spawn

name: Fecundity intercept
description: Fecundity "intercept" (intercept in log-log form) parameter from length to eggs/spawn

name: Hatch rate
description: Percent of successfully hatched individuals per spawning event

name: Interspawn interval
description: Average number of whole days between spawning event

name: Maximum number of spawns per season
description: Maximum number of spawns events per season per individual

name: Start of reproduction season
description: Start of reproduction season

name: End of reproduction season
description: End of reproduction season

name: Daily exposure concentration
description: Chemical exposure concentrations, units must be consistent with effects models

name: Daily Survival Decrement
description: Reduction in daily background survival due to stressor effect

name: Chemical identifier
description: An identifier for the chemical used in the scenario being simulated

name: Lethal concentration (LC)
description: Chemical concentration at which lethal effects for X percent of population occur, the LC in LC_X

name: Percent lethality (X)
description: Percentage lethality associated with Lethal concentration parameter, the X in LC_X

name: Winter size threshold
description: Minimum size for over-winter survival

name: First day of winter
description: The first date for which winter growth, survival, and reproductive effects should take place

name: Last day of winter
description: The last date for which winter growth, survival, and reproductive effects should take place

name: Winter survival rate
description: Daily winter survival for individuals less than the Winter size threshold parameter

name: Winter logical
description: Is it a winter day?
units: TRUE if winter, FALSE if not [boolean]

name: Initial population
description: Number of starting individuals in simulation

name: Initial size distribution
description: Initial distribution of population used for simulation
units: vector of individuals per size class [vector, length=num_of_classes]

name: Number of size classes
description: Integer number of size classes to discretize to in numerical computation of transition matrices

name: Solver order
description: Integer number of sampled sizes per size class in numerical discretization algorithm

name: Chemical Growth Effect logical
description: Are there chemical growth effects?
units: TRUE if growth effects, FALSE if not [boolean]

name: Daily percent growth reduction in K_g parameter
description: Daily percentage reduction in K_g vonBertalanffy growth parameter from chronic effects study

name: Common species name
description: Common species name

name: Scientific name
description: Scientific name
